notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
We just pushed a minor update! This added the difficulty settings right onto the front menu and a couple other minor changes. New stuff is in the works, so keep an eye out!

-TooManyBugs

notes.title: IT's release day.
notes.notes:
IF you are reading this thanks so much for coming by. This is our first game on steam and as we go forward I would like to let you know on some of our plans.

1: we want to do nothing but improve the game. If you have any complants or suggestions feel free to email me at WaxSkink@gmail.com. We want to be very open with our community.

2: We plan on making all add ons free for this game. We have some new level ideas and game mode that we would like to add in the future. Hopefully we can also add online play down the line aswell.

3: I would just like to thank you for coming by and checking out our game even if you end up not buying it. If you do end up plaing it I hope you enjoy your time with it and have an awesome day.
